description: This file defines classes and templates for managing web transfer operations over WebLinkType connections, including client and server transfer types with support for file upload/download, hash validation, and request/response handling within the WPEFramework Web namespace.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a singleton element of type ELEMENT, providing access via the Element() method.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including collecting info, uploading, and downloading files with hash validation.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests for file storage and retrieval with authorization and hash validation.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a destination file.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to setup connection parameters.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when info is collected.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual callback invoked when transfer is complete.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize incoming requests.
